item: slash / popup menus: a menu that opens or redraws under a resting pointer keeps its cursor on the first match; hover moves it only after a real pointer move; and only the cursor is painted, so one row is ever highlighted
branch: js/30-menus.js: a capture keydown clears ptrLive; a mousemove at new screen coordinates sets it and selects the row under the pointer; the document mouseover painter (hoverSel) acts only while ptrLive
provenance: Measured 2026-10-26 in the sandbox over CDP (Input.dispatchMouseEvent to park the pointer on /goal's row, Input.insertText '/con'): every keystroke's redraw produced a mouseover at the parked coordinates and NO mousemove, and the cursor landed on /goal instead of /context — the user's report the same day. The events here are that sequence, synthetic; the command list is a shortened copy of the real menu. The roster order is pinned with an EMPTY recency map (7.12, 2026-10-28): commands earlier fixtures sent would otherwise lead the menu; the last step restores it.

steps.note: 1 — the pointer rests (it moved, then a key was typed) and the menu redraws under it: the redraw's mouseover must NOT move the cursor off the first match
steps.setup: window.__recent103 = cmdRecent; cmdRecent = {}; document.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousemove',{bubbles:true,screenX:1103,screenY:1103})); window.onClaudeEvent(JSON.stringify({type:'__commands',items:[{name:'context',description:'a'},{name:'code-review',description:'b'},{name:'run',description:'c'},{name:'compact',description:'d'},{name:'goal',description:'e'}]})); renderSlash(''); document.getElementById('slashMenu').classList.add('show'); var it=document.querySelectorAll('#slashList .popup-item'); it.forEach(function(x,n){ x.classList.toggle('sel', n===0); }); document.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Shift',bubbles:true})); document.querySelectorAll('#slashList .popup-item')[4].dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseover',{bubbles:true,screenX:1103,screenY:1103}));

expect.why: GUARD: the five commands drawn in order (the built-in /btw follows them)
DISCRIMINATING: the cursor stays on the first match (pre-fix: the row under the resting pointer, /goal)

steps.note: 2 — an event at the SAME spot is not a move: a same-coordinate mousemove does not re-arm the hover

expect.why: DISCRIMINATING: still on the first match

steps.note: 3 — the pointer really moves onto a row: the cursor follows it (hover still picks)

expect.why: a real move selects the row under the pointer

steps.note: 4 — after that move, crossing to another row is an ordinary hover again

expect.why: mouseover moves the cursor while the pointer is live

steps.note: 4b — ONE highlight: no stylesheet rule paints a popup row's background on :hover (the cursor .sel is the only paint, so a resting pointer cannot light a second row beside it — user, 2026-10-26, measured: /context and the parked-on /goal both rgb(44, 57, 76))
